name: Java Tutor
description: A chat window for Java coaching - code blocks, streaming answers, and a searchable history of past lessons.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Nothing to configure. Claude Code must be installed on the machine (it is - the tutor uses the copy already on your PATH).
Your Java files live in C:\Dev\Code Tutor. The tutor reads them from there.
Keep writing your code in Eclipse. This window never touches your files - it can only read them.
how_it_works: Type a question, or paste code straight into the box at the bottom.
The answer streams in word by word. Code arrives in a proper code block with a Copy button.
The tutor can open and read your .java files itself when it needs to see them.
Every conversation is saved. The left sidebar lists past lessons - search them, open one to re-read it, or hit Continue to pick a lesson back up where you left off.
It runs on your existing Claude subscription. There is no extra charge, but it does use your 5-hour usage window - the bar at the bottom shows how much is left.
output: Nothing is written to disk by the tutor. Conversations are saved automatically so you can search and re-read them later.
